fields.label: Allow ERP-permitted screens by default
fields.description: When enabled, existing ERPNext users without a Mobile App Permission record can use screens allowed by their ERPNext permissions. Turn this off to require a per-user mobile screen configuration.

fields.label: Configuration Guide
fields.options: Configure screen visibility per ERPNext user in Mobile App Permissions. Users without a saved profile follow the default setting above. A checked screen never grants ERPNext data permissions; those remain the final authority.
